params.name: origin
params.description: Defines the origin location of the requested market rate data. Can be either a UN/LOCODE or a region as defined in Xeneta's [geo-hierarchy](https://www.xeneta.com/hubfs/2025-ocean-geo/xeneta-ocean-geo.html). For example, `CNSGH` or `china_east_main`.

params.name: destination
params.description: Defines the destination location of the requested market rate data. Can be either a UN/LOCODE or a region as defined in Xeneta's [geo-hierarchy](https://www.xeneta.com/hubfs/2025-ocean-geo/xeneta-ocean-geo.html). For example, `NLRTM` or `north_europe_main`.

params.name: date_from
params.description: Defines the start date of the date range for the requested market rates in the `YYYY-MM-DD` format. The total range cannot exceed 31 days.

params.name: date_to
params.description:
Defines the end date of the date range for the requested market rates in the `YYYY-MM-DD` format. The total range cannot exceed 31 days.

Using a future date will return contracted rates that are valid up to 10 days (when `contract_length` is set to `short`) or 3 months (when `contract_length` is set to `long`) beyond the current date.

params.name: contract_length
params.description: Defines the type of contract for the requested market rate data. Accepted values are `long` or `short`.

params.name: contracted_within
params.description: Defines the maximum age of the contracts to be included in the requested market rate data, relative to each day. Accepted values include `all`, `3months` and `6months`. Using any value other than `all` when `contract_length` is set to `short` will return an error.

params.name: container_type
params.description: Defines the container type of the requested market rate data. Accepted values include `20DC`, `20RE`, `20TK`, `40DC`, `40RH` and `40HC`.

params.name: thc_methodology
params.description: Defines whether the requested market rate data should include the terminal handling charge. Accepted values include `meth`, `othc`, `dthc`, `none` and `both`. Selecting `meth` will use Xeneta's default [methodology](https://help.xeneta.com/docs/terminal-handling-charges) for the requested `origin` and `destination`.

params.name: bump_up
params.description: Defines whether to allow rates from larger geographic regions in the response if there is not enough data for the requested `origin` and `destination`. Using `false` when there is no rate data available for the requested `origin` and `destination` will return an error.
